body: @nknize please could you take a look?
I just tried this out in 5.0.0-alpha2 and it's still showing the same behavior.

> it appears that somewhere around a 6,000mi distance, the bounding box generated by the GeoPointDistanceQueryImpl query maxes out

hmmm... This sounds like could be a units issue with `maxRadialDistance`?  I'll try to reproduce and see what's going on.

If I shift the query origin further north then the max distance become less before the bounding box stops growing. For example, when using location _71.284992,-156.9219567_ (Barrow, AK) the bounding box stops changing at a query distance of around 2,600 miles.

I'm also assuming that the _Lower Left: [x,y], Upper Right: [x,y]_ being reported by the GeoPointDistanceQueryImpl lucene query when running the query profiler is the bounding box. Hopefully I'm not wrong on that!
Ah. This was a radius restriction bug that was fixed in https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/LUCENE-7137.
@nknize: Any chance of that fix getting applied to a 2.3.x release?

Possibly 2.3.x, that might be a stretch. At minimum it should really make 5.0 but as it stands right now the fix isn't available until Lucene 6.1 which means 5.x. I'll dig and keep this issue updated.
@nknize I noticed that alpha4 is using Lucene 6.1 so I re-ran this test. It's still exhibiting the same unexpected behavior.
@jweber I still had the radial restriction in ES. I just pushed a fix that will be in the next release.

Do you guys have any suggestions for a workaround for this in 2.3.x? Or is the best we can do is validate the user's query before passing it along to ES? Does it sound reasonable to validate that GeoUtils.maxRadialDistance() doesn't shrink the input distance?
